Job Summary

AceNet Consulting is seeking a skilled Backend Developer with 6+ years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python and Node.js, REST API development, PostgreSQL, cloud deployments on Microsoft Azure, and CI/CD automation. Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) and Node.js.
Build robust, secure, and high-performance RESTful APIs for enterprise applications.
Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning.
Integrate backend services with frontend applications and third-party APIs.
Develop secure authentication and authorization mechanisms following industry best practices.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability for production environments.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application defects and production issues.
Deploy and manage backend services on Microsoft Azure App Services and Azure cloud environments.
Implement source control and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and development best practices.
Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Required Skills
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in backend application development.
Strong expertise in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and Node.js.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, database design, query optimization, and indexing.
Experience integrating backend services with frontend applications and third-party APIs.
Hands-on experience deploying applications on Microsoft Azure App Services and Azure cloud platforms.
Experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control and CI/CD automation.
Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and backend security best practices.
Experience troubleshooting, debugging, and optimizing backend applications.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Good to Have
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Exposure to Azure DevOps or other CI/CD platforms.
Knowledge of message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with caching technologies such as Redis.
Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cosmos DB.
Experience working on enterprise-scale digital transformation or consulting projects.
Exposure to automated testing frameworks and API testing tools.
Experience mentoring junior developers and participating in technical code reviews.
Why Join Us
Opportunities to work on transformative projects and cutting-edge technologies with leading global organizations.
Continuous investment in learning, upskilling, and professional development.
Competitive compensation, benefits, ESOPs, and international assignment opportunities.
Supportive work environment with a strong focus on work-life balance and employee well-being.
Open and collaborative culture that values innovation, diversity, and individual contributions.
